title: Singapore
description: A short loop through Kampong Glam — mosque courtyards, painted shophouses, and the lane that still feels like a village street.
footnote: Walked on foot from Sultan Mosque to Arab Street. Pins are places to pause, not a timed itinerary.

stops.title: Sultan Mosque
stops.description: Start under the gold dome. The courtyard is the quietest moment before the street fills in.

stops.title: Haji Lane
stops.description: One block of murals, small shops, and the slow shuffle of people taking the same photo you just took.

stops.title: Arab Street
stops.description: Textiles in the windows and coffee on the five-foot way. A good place to end without rushing the next stop.
